expectations.text: Gathers references specifically for B2B analytics dashboards
expectations.evidence: Curates references from Mixpanel, Amplitude, Datadog, Grafana, Linear and other B2B analytics products with specific screen examples

expectations.text: Filters for the 'modern but professional' aesthetic
expectations.evidence: Creates aesthetic spectrum (playful—modern—corporate) and positions references along it, filtering to the modern-professional zone

expectations.text: Identifies patterns in data visualization, layout, typography, and color usage
expectations.evidence: Breaks down patterns: inter/system font stacks, muted blue-gray palettes, card-based chart containers, whitespace-heavy layouts, subtle data viz colors

expectations.text: Compares different visual approaches (dark vs light, card-based vs data-dense)
expectations.evidence: Produces comparison matrix: dark mode (Grafana-style) vs light (Linear-style), card-based (Mixpanel) vs data-dense (Datadog), with pros/cons for B2B context

expectations.text: Produces a curated reference collection that defines the visual direction
expectations.evidence: Outputs design-references.md with curated collection, aesthetic positioning, pattern analysis, and recommended visual direction summary
